product.summary: Current MathWallet mobile wallet application for multichain Web3 use on iOS and Android.
product.notes: Selected mobile boundary only; browser wallet is deferred. Custody remains unknown pending stronger current first-party terms rather than being inferred from security guidance alone.

evidence.title: Security Guide of Math Wallet
evidence.notes: Official security guidance establishes user-held mnemonic/private-key backup workflows but does not by itself justify a stronger current provider-custody claim, so custody remains unknown.

evidence.title: MathWallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party MathWallet site distributes iPhone and Android builds and documents the multichain wallet product, supporting active maintenance.
